halfLife.notes: Parent half-life is short (~3h) but the clinically active metabolite 9-OH-risperidone (paliperidone) has a 24h half-life and dominates exposure. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: 9-OH-risperidone (paliperidone)
activeMetabolite.notes: Active metabolite is itself marketed as paliperidone. Combined effective half-life ~20h, supports once-daily dosing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors (paroxetine, fluoxetine, bupropion) raise risperidone levels meaningfully. Relevant on cross-taper with these antidepressants. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Less weight gain than olanzapine but more than aripiprazole. Monitor weight, glucose, lipids quarterly. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: Risperdal Consta (every 2 weeks). Paliperidone palmitate (Invega Sustenna monthly, Invega Trinza 3-monthly) is a closely related option. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Less anticholinergic rebound than olanzapine but relapse risk on abrupt stop. Gradual taper preferred. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Tablets and oral solution available. EPS risk rises sharply above 6 mg/day in most patients. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
